etymology.historical_story: Rang illustrates how an older word for a draft or model can remain familiar through a fixed institutional expression. Malaysian readers encounter it especially in rang undang-undang. Kamus Dewan also cross-refers this sense to rangrangan, meaning a draft. Its separate entry for rang meaning rank must not be treated as evidence that the draft sense has the same origin. [DBP: rang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=rang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rang 记成等待讨论的草案：rang undang-undang＝法律还在草案阶段，即法案。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示创作、设想或其成果的名词。词根末尾 a 与后缀 a 分属两个音节；首音节读 é /e/，不是 e pepet /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 虚构出来的故事、人物或内容；编造之物。
senses.en_definition: An invented story, character, or account; a fabrication.
senses.ms_definition: Cerita, watak atau keterangan yang diwujudkan melalui imaginasi, bukan berdasarkan kejadian sebenar.
senses.nuances: 在文学中可中性地表示虚构；用于指责他人的陈述时，则含编造、不真实之意。cerita rekaan 中的 rekaan 修饰名词，但仍保留名词来源。义项划分依据 [DBP：rekaan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rekaan)。

senses.zh_definition: 经构思或设计而产生的作品、样式或发明；设计成果。
senses.en_definition: A design, creation, or invention produced through creative thought.
senses.ms_definition: Hasil pemikiran kreatif yang berupa ciptaan, bentuk atau susunan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常用于服装、产品、图案和技术创新，通常为中性或褒义；不能因其与“虚构”共用一个词，就理解为假冒产品。

senses.zh_definition: 在头脑中构成的想象、幻想或设想。
senses.en_definition: An imagined conception, fantasy, or mental plan.
senses.ms_definition: Gambaran atau rancangan yang terbentuk dalam fikiran dan belum semestinya menjadi kenyataan.
senses.nuances: 强调头脑中的构想，与义项一、二有交叠。表示正式实施计划时，rancangan 通常更明确；rekaan 可突出想象性。

senses.zh_definition: 推算、估计或计算所得的判断。
senses.en_definition: A reckoning, estimate, or calculation.
senses.ms_definition: Hasil mengagak atau menghitung sesuatu untuk memperoleh perkiraan.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录此义，但现代日常用语中较少见，通常改用 anggaran、perkiraan 或 pengiraan。以下为说明旧有义项的组合示例，不应视为现代高频固定搭配。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价作品时，rekaan yang menarik 是自然的赞语；直接说他人的陈述是 rekaan，可能构成对其诚信的指责。

etymology.historical_story: Rekaan is transparently formed from reka and the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings connect storytelling, invention, imagination, and even reckoning: things first take shape in thought. In contemporary usage, context makes the difference between a designer's creation and somebody's fabricated account. This narrative describes its semantic range rather than asserting an uncertain ancient origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 re-ka-an 三拍读：reka 是“构思”，-an 把构思变成“构思出来的东西”——可以是一件设计，也可以是一段虚构故事。

morphology.pattern_note: 借词整词作为独立词素记忆，不拆成 re- 与 laks。首音节读 é /e/；末尾 ks 同属一个音节。添加 -kan 时保留词根末尾 s。

senses.zh_definition: 不紧张、不受压力催迫的；放松的，轻松自在的。

senses.nuances: 可描述人的状态或活动气氛。口语中的 Relaks! 起劝人放松的作用，不必据此另立为及物动词。标准拼写为 relaks；DBP 也建议按语境使用 santai 或 tenang。参见 [DBP：relaks](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=relaks)。

etymology.historical_story: Relaks is the Malay adaptation of English relax, with the final sound sequence represented by ks. Its established Malay meaning emphasizes a calm state or relaxed atmosphere. DBP explicitly confirms relaks as the correct spelling when answering a question about English relax, showing how a familiar borrowed expression becomes part of standardized Malay vocabulary.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 relax 的结尾 x 换写成 ks，就是 relaks；读 re-laks 时松开肩膀，直接把声音和“放松”连起来。

morphology.pattern_note: rusuk 是不可再作现代词缀分析的词根；meN- 遇 r- 采用 me-，形成 merusuk，r 保留。音节据标准拼写补全；词尾 -k 在常见马来西亚标准语音中实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。

word_family.gloss: 沿侧面移动；侧卧；从侧面刺

senses.zh_definition: 身体左侧或右侧的胁部、侧腹；也可指其他物体的侧面。
senses.en_definition: The side or flank of the body; the side of an object.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian sisi tubuh, khususnya kawasan di kiri atau kanan dada.
senses.nuances: 指身体部位时不一定专指骨头，不能机械地一律译为 rib。Rusuk kanan 可以表示右侧胁部。义项参见 [DBP：rusuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=rusuk)。

senses.zh_definition: 肋骨；胸廓两侧弯曲的骨条。
senses.en_definition: A rib: one of the curved bones forming the rib cage.
senses.ms_definition: Tulang melengkung pada sisi dada yang membentuk rangka rusuk.
senses.nuances: 常以 tulang rusuk 明确表示骨骼；rusuk 单独出现时也可指肋骨。Sangkar rusuk 指整个胸廓骨架，不是单根肋骨。

senses.zh_definition: 物体的边缘、侧边或外围部分。
senses.en_definition: The edge, margin, or lateral boundary of something.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian tepi atau pinggir sesuatu benda atau kawasan.
senses.nuances: 这一侧边义在若干固定搭配中保留，日常泛指边缘时 tepi 更常用。Rusuk surat 指信件或纸面的边缘；词典中的 rusuk jalan 指大路旁的小路，而不只是路肩。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: rusuk 是中性的身体部位词，可用于日常交流及正式说明。询问不熟悉的人时，用 bahagian rusuk tuan/puan 比直接使用 kau 更礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 人体语境中应分清“胁部”与“肋骨”。惯用语 tumbuk rusuk 可指行贿，涉及他人时带有严重指控意味；不能仅按字面理解为击打肋部。

etymology.historical_story: Rusuk belongs to an old Austronesian word family associated with ribs and the rib cage. Comparative records connect Malay with related forms across island Southeast Asia and beyond. Some relatives also name roof rafters or canoe supports, revealing how curved structural pieces can be understood through the shape of a body's ribs. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-s_r2.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 双手扶住身体两侧说 ru-suk：扶着的是胁部，里面一根根的是 tulang rusuk。

morphology.pattern_note: ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/，后接 /k/；派生时 meN- 在 /r/ 前表现为 me-，如 merangka，词根的 r 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 骨骼；骨架：构成人或动物身体支撑结构的整套骨头。
senses.en_definition: The skeleton or supporting arrangement of bones in a human or animal body.
senses.ms_definition: Tulang-tulangan tubuh; kerangka.
senses.nuances: 指整体骨骼结构；单根骨头通常称 tulang。tinggal rangka 可夸张形容人瘦得只剩骨头，对人直接使用可能伤人。

senses.zh_definition: 框架；构架：支撑建筑物、车辆或其他物体的基本结构。
senses.en_definition: The supporting frame or structural framework of a building, vehicle, or other object.
senses.ms_definition: Tulang-tulangan rumah atau sesuatu benda; kerangka.
senses.nuances: 侧重承重或支撑的基本构造，例如房屋骨架和自行车车架；不必然包括外壳、墙面或装饰。

senses.zh_definition: 纲要；框架；初步方案：交代整体结构和主要内容、尚未展开细节的计划或草稿。
senses.en_definition: An outline, draft, or general plan setting out the main structure without detailed development.
senses.ms_definition: Buram, bagan atau rancangan yang menyeluruh dan tidak terperinci.
senses.nuances: 常用于作文、项目及政策规划。dalam rangka 可表示“在……框架内”或“作为……工作的一部分”。rangka 不等于 rangkaian“网络；系列”。义项依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=rangka)。

etymology.historical_story: Dalam bahasa Melayu, rangka menghubungkan tubuh, rumah dan rancangan melalui satu gambaran: struktur yang menyokong keseluruhan. Kamus merekodkan rangka basikal dan rangka rumah bersama makna bagan atau rancangan umum. Hubungan ini boleh difahami sebagai metafora tulang kepada susunan idea. Ia membantu menjelaskan makna, tetapi tidak menetapkan urutan sejarah perubahan makna tersebut. Sumber: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=rangka).

etymology.historical_story: Asal sejarah jauh kata rogol tidak dapat dipastikan daripada sumber yang dirujuk. Namun, kamus Melayu memperlihatkan satu keluarga yang jelas: rogol menamakan perbuatan, merogol menamakan tindakan, dan perogol menamakan pelaku. Takrif lama menggunakan bahasa kehormatan perempuan. Ketika mempelajarinya, bezakan ungkapan budaya dalam takrif itu daripada maruah mangsa, yang tidak berkurang akibat keganasan. Sumber: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rogol).

etymology.historical_story: Rebecca comes from the Hebrew name Rivqa and is associated with the biblical wife of Isaac and mother of Esau and Jacob. etymology.historical_story: A familiar spelling can conceal a regional word. The supplied Kamus Dewan entry labels rabu as Minangkabau and defines it as lungs. Its food expression dendeng rabu preserves that meaning in the kitchen, while sakit rabu names lung illness. These uses offer a cultural memory route without claiming an unverified ancient origin or connecting this noun to Wednesday.

etymology.historical_story: Malay rasa connects the tongue with inner experience: a person can taste food, feel pain, and experience affection through the same lexical family. Rasakannya combines that base with -kan and the attached pronoun -nya. Its reference therefore comes from the conversation: the thing being experienced may be a flavour, a sensation, or an emotional experience. [DBP: rasa](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=1&k=rasa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 rasa＝味道／感受，再把 -nya 理解为“它”：rasakannya＝尝尝它／感受它。

morphology.formula: ∅ + rip → rip; rest in peace → RIP
morphology.pattern_note: 必须区分英语整词 rip 与悼念缩写 RIP。前者通常一个音节，后者可逐字母读 R-I-P；输入包没有上下文，不能确定实际指哪一种。两者均不作马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: RIP：愿逝者安息，用于悼念死者的缩写表达。
senses.en_definition: RIP, an abbreviation of rest in peace, used as a memorial wish for someone who has died.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan ungkapan bahasa Inggeris rest in peace yang digunakan untuk menyampaikan harapan agar seseorang yang telah meninggal dunia bersemadi dengan aman.
senses.nuances: 通常写作 RIP 或 R.I.P.；聊天中的小写 rip 可能表达同义。它是完整悼念用语的缩写，并非普通马来语名词；particle 是在指定词性选项中的功能性归类。official 沿用指定数据标签，不表示 DBP 将其认定为标准马来语词。马来文释义为编写说明。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/rip)。

senses.zh_definition: 撕裂；撕开；突然用力扯开；也可指物体被扯破。

etymology.historical_story: This spelling brings together distinct English uses. Lowercase rip names tearing and, in computing, extracting recorded media. Uppercase RIP abbreviates rest in peace, a memorial expression. Without capitalization or surrounding text, the packet cannot establish which was intended. Keeping the readings separate prevents a condolence message from being interpreted as an instruction to tear something. [Dictionary reference](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/rip).

senses.ms_definition: Pasir; negeri ramal bermaksud negeri Arab.
senses.nuances: 现代日常表示“沙”通常使用 pasir。negeri ramal 是传统表达，不宜据此把 ramal 当作任何场景都可替换 pasir 的常用词。依据：[DBP PRPM：ramal I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=ramal+I)。

senses.zh_definition: 占卜所用的沙或其他凭据、工具、典籍，用来推断命运或未来之事。
senses.en_definition: Sand or other materials, objects, or texts used to divine fortunes or future events.
senses.ms_definition: Pasir untuk menengok nasib, atau sesuatu yang digunakan untuk melihat nasib atau mengetahui sesuatu yang akan berlaku, seperti kitab nujum.
senses.nuances: 这是输入词典材料中的核心名词义。membaca ramal 通常指占卜，不是阅读现代统计预测。相关表达带有传统占卜语境。依据：[DBP PRPM：ramal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ramal)。

senses.zh_definition: 预测、推测或预言未来之事；是 meramal、meramalkan 等形式的动词词根。
senses.en_definition: To predict, forecast, or divine what will happen; the verbal base of meramal and meramalkan.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk dasar bagi perbuatan menelah atau menjangkakan sesuatu yang akan berlaku.
senses.nuances: 正式主动句通常使用 meramal 或 meramalkan；裸词 ramal 可自然用于 saya ramal 等第一人称被动结构，也常见于省略 meN- 的口语。现代预测是否可靠取决于依据，词本身不保证准确，也不必然涉及占卜。释义概括自 [DBP 的派生词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=ramal+I)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies ramal I as Arabic-derived and records both sand and materials used in divination. These meanings offer a memorable bridge from sand to fortune-telling, while derivatives such as ramalan also serve modern prediction. etymology.historical_story: Rogers has more than one surname history. The Dictionary of American Family Names links an English form to Roger, while also recording an Irish adoption from Gaelic Mac Ruaidhrí. A familiar spelling therefore need not imply one ancestry. In Malay text, the name is normally retained rather than translated or treated as an ordinary derived word. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/rogers).

etymology.historical_story: Reese belongs to a group of English spellings associated with the Welsh personal name Rhys. As Welsh names circulated in English writing, forms such as Rees and Reece helped represent unfamiliar sounds. These spellings became established names rather than Malay vocabulary. Their appearance in Malay texts usually reflects references to people, not a new Malay lexical root. See [the onomastic study](https://ans-names.pitt.edu/ans/article/download/1187/1186/2376).

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan preserves three homonyms under rak: an imitative sound word, a household storage structure, and a Kelantan term for sparse scrub. The sound entry points readers to derak and records rak-rok for breaking trees. These records capture different strands of Malay vocabulary; they do not establish a common historical origin for the three homonyms. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=rak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 rak 时在元音后突然收住喉头：[raʔ]。用两个画面分别记忆：书放在架子上；木头突然“咔”地折断。同音不代表同一词源。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary record presents rapi as a word whose meanings extend from neat appearance to orderly work, secure closure, vigilance, and meticulous attention. These related uses offer a memorable cultural picture of things being properly attended to. Its derivatives include merapikan and kerapian; the supplied segmentation into rap plus i should not be treated as an established origin. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=rapi).

senses.en_definition: A propulsion device, vehicle, projectile, or firework driven by an expelled jet.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris bagi alat, kenderaan, peluru atau bunga api yang bergerak melalui tujahan bahan yang dipancutkan; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah roket.
senses.nuances: 未核实 rocket 为规范马来语词头；此处提供英语词义与马来语对应词，不冒称 DBP 官方释义。音标为英式英语读音。rocket → roket 的拼写对应见 [DBP/MABBIM 文献](https://mabbim.dbp.my/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/hha97.pdf)；英语义项见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/rocket)。以下保留英语搭配。

collocations.zh: 火箭发动机；马来语：enjin roket

senses.zh_definition: 英式英语中的芝麻菜，即常用于沙拉、带辛香味的叶菜；美式英语常称 arugula。
senses.en_definition: A peppery salad plant, also called arugula.
senses.ms_definition: Nama bahasa Inggeris British bagi sayuran berdaun berasa pedas yang digunakan dalam salad, juga dikenali sebagai arugula.
senses.nuances: 菜单中的 rocket 可能是蔬菜，不能机械译为 roket。此植物名称与航天器名称具有不同词源。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/rocket) 和 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rocket)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词：急速上升、猛增或飞速移动；也可指用火箭运送或推进。
senses.en_definition: To rise or move very rapidly, or to propel by rocket.
senses.ms_definition: Kata kerja bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud meningkat atau bergerak dengan sangat cepat, atau menggerakkan sesuatu dengan roket.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词用法；马来语应按语境使用 melonjak、meluncur 或以 roket 构成的说明性短语。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rocket)。

collocations.zh: 迅速成名；马来语：menjadi terkenal dengan cepat

etymology.historical_story: The flying rocket and the salad rocket have different histories. Merriam-Webster traces the flying device's name to Italian rocchetta, meaning a small distaff, while the vegetable name follows a separate route connected with Latin eruca. Malay uses the adapted spelling roket for the flying device. The spelling resemblance therefore hides two distinct origins, making context essential when reading English menus or science texts. [History](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rocket) [Malay adaptation](https://mabbim.dbp.my/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/hha97.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rocket 发射到马来语里，拼写变成 roket；但菜单上的 rocket 留在盘子里，是芝麻菜。

senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan dalam bahasa Inggeris, jalan atau proses yang membawa kepada sesuatu hasil.
senses.nuances: 此义属于英语。以下搭配保留英语形式供辨识，并非马来语固定搭配；翻译时依语境使用 jalan menuju、usaha mencapai 等表达。[DBP：road 的比喻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=road)

etymology.historical_story: Here road belongs to the English layer encountered in Malaysian bilingual communication. DBP treats its meanings in the English–Malay dictionary and supplies jalan as the equivalent. Expressions such as road trip also receive Malay translations. The useful cultural story is therefore one of language contact, with English expressions appearing alongside established Malay alternatives. [DBP: road](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=road)

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 按要求保留词包值；实际语言学词根为 rusuh，而 rusuhan 是加 -an 构成的事件名词，因此 is_root 标为 false。词根末尾 h 保留，接元音后缀后音节划分为 ru.su.han。DBP 将 rusuhan 列为 rusuh 的派生词。[DBP 构词资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399076&keyword=rusuhan)

senses.zh_definition: 骚乱；一群人扰乱公共秩序的事件，常伴随暴力、冲突或破坏。
senses.en_definition: A riot or outbreak of collective disorder, often involving violence or damage.
senses.ms_definition: Kejadian merusuh.
senses.nuances: 指扰乱公共秩序的事件，不泛指热闹、吵闹或个别争执。不能把所有 perhimpunan“集会”或 demonstrasi“示威”都称为 rusuhan；本词也不必然包含推翻政权的目的，通常不直接译为“起义”。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399076&keyword=rusuhan)

etymology.historical_story: Rusuhan belongs to a Malay word family organized around rusuh, a state of disorder. The suffix -an gives that disorder an event name, while merusuh describes the activity and perusuh identifies a participant. This family is useful when reading public affairs: an account can distinguish what happened, what people did, and who took part. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399076&keyword=rusuhan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ru-su-han：先记 rusuh“乱起来”，再加 -an，把“乱”变成一场“骚乱事件”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在现代马来语中作为完整借词词基处理，不能把词尾 -tis 当成能产马来语后缀。按 ro.man.tis 三个音节读；下列词族成员是相关借词，不是由 romantis 加马来语词缀直接生成。

senses.zh_definition: 浪漫的；与爱情、柔情、美感或令人向往的亲密氛围有关的。
senses.en_definition: Romantic; associated with love, affection, beauty, or an atmosphere that evokes these feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan percintaan dan keindahan dan lain-lain; romantik.
senses.nuances: 可形容人物、举动、故事、景色或气氛，并不只指恋爱关系，也不必含有性意味。DBP 将其释为 romantik；在文学语境中也可修饰强调情感的诗歌或作家，但不能把所有此类用例都理解为爱情题材。[DBP 释义与双语例证](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=romantis)

etymology.historical_story: Romantis belongs to the international vocabulary of romance and romantic feeling. European forms developed around narratives, imagination, and emotionally charged beauty; their meanings later extended to affectionate relationships and evocative scenery. Malay dictionaries likewise allow romantis to describe both love and beauty. The broader history explains why a landscape can be romantis without depicting a couple. [Historical study](https://www.dbnl.org/tekst/berg018ontw01_01/berg018ontw01_01_0004.php), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=romantis)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ro-man-tis 与英语 romantic 音形相近：想象海边、柔光、温柔气氛，一起记住“浪漫”。

morphology.pattern_note: 共两音节，词根不发生音变。常见组合 bulu roma、liang roma 属于合成表达，并非加缀派生。DBP 另收 seroma，意为相同、相似，不能据此把裸词 roma 解释为日常通用的相似。

word_family.gloss: 汗毛；身体上的细毛，属合成表达

senses.zh_definition: 人体皮肤上细软的毛；汗毛，通常说 bulu roma。
senses.en_definition: Fine, soft hair on the human body, usually in the expression bulu roma.
senses.ms_definition: Bulu halus yang tumbuh pada badan manusia, lazimnya disebut bulu roma.
senses.nuances: roma 本身指细毛；毛孔是完整组合 liang roma 或 lubang roma 的意思，不应另立为裸词 roma 的独立义。bulu roma meremang、berdiri bulu roma 可描述受惊、寒冷或强烈感动时汗毛竖起，具体原因由语境确定。依据 [DBP：roma](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=roma)。

etymology.historical_story: Roma belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary recorded in older studies of Malay. William Edward Maxwell's manual pairs Malay roma, meaning body hair, with Sanskrit roman. Modern Malay commonly uses bulu roma. Its figurative expressions make a small physical detail memorable: fear can be described through the body's fine hairs standing upright. See [Maxwell's A Manual of the Malay Language](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/25604/pg25604-images.html).

etymology.historical_story: English raven continues Old English hræfn and belongs to a Germanic word family that includes German Rabe. Historical European records also show related bird words used as personal names. This helps explain the connection between the bird and the name Raven, while leaving the meaning of any particular occurrence dependent on capitalization and context. Sources: [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/raven_1), [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/2015/3/name/Raven).

etymology.historical_story: Rahsiakan combines the Malay suffix -kan with rahsia, a word associated with Sanskrit rahasya, meaning secret or private. The World Loanword Database documents this Sanskrit source for the related Indonesian form rahasia. In Malaysian Malay, the shorter root rahsia takes ordinary Malay morphology, producing a direct instruction to keep something undisclosed. The borrowed root is remembered as a whole. [Loanword evidence](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839445244510)

etymology.historical_story: Rahsia is traced to Sanskrit rahasya, associated with secrecy and private knowledge; rahsianya combines that borrowed base with Malay -nya. The complete form therefore joins an older lexical inheritance to living Malay grammar. Today it can introduce either someone's concealed information or, more warmly, the practical secret behind an excellent dish or a successful undertaking. [Etymological reference](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/ocr/1595120/610)

senses.zh_definition: 双方或多方为解决分歧、处理问题或达成协议而进行的商谈；协商；谈判。

senses.ms_definition: Perbincangan antara dua pihak atau lebih untuk menyelesaikan masalah atau mencapai persetujuan.
senses.nuances: 强调通过商谈寻找共识，可以涉及价格、劳资关系或和平安排，不必存在激烈冲突。rundingan 是名词，表示“进行商议”时用 berunding。马来语释义据 DBP 释义展开改写。参见 [DBP：runding 及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=runding)。

senses.nuances: DBP 收录的内容义，现代日常使用中不如“谈判、协商”义常见。表示某人的意见或劝告时，pendapat 或 nasihat 通常更直接。以下搭配用于明确指向商谈内容，并非独立固定成语。参见 [DBP：rundingan 的第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=runding)。

etymology.historical_story: Rundingan is formed from runding with the noun-forming suffix -an. DBP records older meanings of runding involving reckoning and consideration, alongside serious discussion. This semantic range connects weighing a matter with talking it through. In contemporary use, rundingan commonly names the discussions through which parties seek agreement or settle differences. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=runding).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: runding 是“认真商量”，加 -an 把动作变成一场“商谈”：berunding 做动作，rundingan 指谈判。

etymology.historical_story: Ramuan belongs to the Malay family built around ramu, gathering materials for use. Dictionary examples connect this activity with roots and leaves for medicine, and timber for houses. The noun therefore reaches beyond the kitchen. Its figurative use invites another image: success, like a carefully prepared dish, depends on bringing suitable elements together.

etymology.historical_story: Rishabh is a modern personal-name form associated with Sanskrit ṛṣabha. Sanskrit dictionaries record meanings including 'bull' and, especially in compounds, 'the best' or 'chief'. The historical word also occurs as a personal name. These associations explain the name's linguistic background; they do not make Rishabh a Malay word for an animal or a description of every person bearing the name. [Sanskrit dictionary evidence](https://www.wisdomlib.org/definition/rishabha).

etymology.historical_story: Rhodes enters this entry as an unresolved proper name rather than a verified Malay common word. One established reference is the Greek island; another is the surname commemorated by the Rhodes Scholarship, established through Cecil Rhodes's will in 1902. These references must remain distinct until the original context identifies the intended one. [希腊国家旅游机构](https://www.visitgreece.gr/en/mainland/islands/rhodes)；[牛津大学](https://www.campaign.ox.ac.uk/rhodes)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看前面的词：Pulau Rhodes 是岛；Biasiswa Rhodes 是奖学金。靠语境认专名，不靠字母硬拆词根。

senses.ms_definition: Tumbuhan renek daripada genus Rosa serta bunganya, yang juga disebut mawar.
senses.nuances: ros 与 mawar 在一般用语中同指玫瑰，bunga ros 强调花，pokok ros 强调植株。中文日常可译“玫瑰”，但植物学范围是 Rosa 属，不限于单一物种。释义依据输入包所引《Kamus Dewan》第四版。大写人名 Ros 须按人名处理。

etymology.historical_story: Malay has two familiar names for the rose: ros and mawar. Their coexistence lets speakers identify the same flower through different lexical forms. Ros resembles European flower names such as English rose and Dutch roos, but resemblance alone cannot establish a precise borrowing route. The supplied dictionary evidence establishes its botanical meaning, rather than a dated history of transmission.

morphology.formula: ∅ + rileks → rileks（非规范口语拼写；规范形式为 relaks）
morphology.pattern_note: 作为整词记忆，不拆分 ri- 或 -leks。rileks 与规范拼写 relaks 的对应属于拼写和语音变体，不是加词缀过程。所列 IPA 是按该口语拼写推定的读音，不是 DBP 核定音标。

使放松；使松弛，派生自 relaks

senses.zh_definition: 非规范口语形式：放松的、轻松的或不紧张的；规范马来语拼写为 relaks。
senses.en_definition: An informal, nonstandard spelling of relaks: relaxed, calm, or free from pressure.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi relaks, iaitu tenang, santai atau bebas daripada tekanan.
senses.nuances: Rilekslah! 在口语中可用于劝人放松或别紧张。语气过于随便时也可能让对方觉得其忧虑被轻视。以下搭配用于展示口语形式；正式文字应采用 relaks。

etymology.historical_story: Rileks is associated with English relax and corresponds to the standard Malay spelling relaks. DBP explicitly recommends relaks rather than rileks or releks. The contrast offers a practical lesson in borrowing: a familiar conversational spelling can circulate alongside a codified form, while formal Malay writing follows the established spelling.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见 ri-leks 就想到 relax、放轻松；正式写作再记一步：马来语规范写 relaks。

senses.zh_definition: 阻碍行动、进展或目标实现的障碍、阻力或干扰。
senses.en_definition: An obstacle, hindrance, or interference that impedes movement or progress.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang merintangi; halangan atau gangguan.
senses.nuances: 既可指实际障碍物，也可指资金、制度或个人处境造成的困难。比 masalah 更突出“挡住前进”的作用，不必然含有人为敌意。释义及构词依据：[DBP：rintang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=rintang)。

senses.zh_definition: 电阻；电路元件对电流的阻碍程度，以其两端电压与流经电流的比值表示，单位为欧姆。
senses.en_definition: Electrical resistance: the ratio of the potential difference across a component to the current through it, measured in ohms.
senses.ms_definition: Nisbah beza keupayaan merentasi sesuatu komponen elektrik kepada arus yang mengalir melaluinya.
senses.nuances: 物理与电学术语。rintangan 指电阻这一物理量，perintang 指电阻器；kerintangan 指电阻率。定义依据：[DBP：学校科学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=rintangan+elektrik)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论工作困难时，以具体情况作主语较为得体，如 kekurangan dana menjadi rintangan；直接说某人是 rintangan 容易显得指责。

etymology.historical_story: Rintangan is formed from rintang with the noun-forming suffix -an. The related vocabulary includes things lying across a route and actions that obstruct progress. This provides a useful bridge between physical barriers and difficulties in life. Scientific Malay also uses rintangan for electrical resistance, giving obstruction a precise measurable application.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rintang 是“挡住”，加 -an 变成“挡路的障碍”；生活有阻碍，电流有电阻。

senses.zh_definition: 英语：实际存在或发生的；真实的，而非虚构或想象的。
senses.en_definition: Actually existing or occurring, rather than imagined or invented.
senses.ms_definition: Benar-benar wujud atau berlaku; bukan khayalan atau rekaan.
senses.nuances: DBP 的相关检索结果将 real 列在《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》的英语词条下，不能据此认定它是正式马来语词。马来语可按语境用 sebenar、nyata 或 benar。以下搭配采用规范马来语对译。见 [DBP：real](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=real)。

collocations.en: a real story; a true story

senses.zh_definition: 英语：真正的、货真价实的；非仿制或伪造的。
senses.en_definition: Genuine or authentic, rather than artificial or counterfeit.
senses.ms_definition: Asli atau tulen; bukan tiruan atau palsu.
senses.nuances: 强调真伪或材质，与上一义的“是否实际存在”有所区别。马来语中的 asli、tulen、sebenar 不能在所有搭配中互换；应根据对象选择。释义为编写的马来语对译。见 [Merriam-Webster：real](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/real)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语专业用法：数学中指实数的；经济学中指扣除价格变动影响后的实际值。
senses.en_definition: In mathematics, relating to real numbers; in economics, adjusted for changes in prices.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam matematik, berkaitan dengan nombor nyata; dalam ekonomi, diselaraskan untuk mengambil kira perubahan harga.
senses.nuances: 两个领域的马来语对应词不同：数学通常用 nyata，经济学通常用 benar 或 sebenar，须遵循具体术语。它们不是把英语 real 原样当作马来语形容词使用。见 [DBP：real](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=real)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语非正式用法，尤见于美式英语：很；非常。
senses.en_definition: Very; used informally, especially in American English.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat atau betul-betul, dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris tidak formal.
senses.nuances: 这是英语副词用法，不是已核实的马来语程度副词。例如 real good 的马来语对应表达是 sangat bagus。以下列的是对应表达。见 [DBP：real](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=real)。

etymology.historical_story: The English adjective real came through French from Latin forms associated with res, meaning a thing or fact. Its history connects reality with things that exist. Currency names spelled real have a different route through words meaning royal, so identical spelling does not guarantee a shared origin. See [Merriam-Webster: real](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/real).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: real＝真的：问存在，用 nyata；问事情真假，用 sebenar；问材质或真品，用 asli 或 tulen，搭配决定选词。

etymology.historical_story: Rakesh belongs to an Indian naming tradition rooted in Sanskrit. Its historical components are rākā, referring to the full moon, and īśa, meaning lord or ruler, yielding the conventional interpretation “lord of the full moon.” In Malay usage it functions as a person's name; that historical interpretation is not an everyday Malay noun meaning. [Name etymology](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rakesh).

etymology.historical_story: Rapunzel's name comes from the plant coveted by her mother in the German tale. Her father takes it from a sorceress's garden and promises the unborn child in return. The sorceress later names the girl Rapunzel. The German plant name has several botanical interpretations, so the narrative connection is firmer than identifying one universally agreed species. [Grimm text and scholarly notes](https://sites.pitt.edu/~dash/grimm012.html)

etymology.historical_story: Republik belongs to an international political vocabulary ultimately associated with Latin res publica, meaning public affairs or the commonwealth. The expression directs attention to the community's affairs rather than a ruler's private possession. This explains a useful conceptual association, but the exact language through which the Malay form was borrowed is not established here. [Australian Parliament discussion](https://www.aph.gov.au/binaries/senate/pubs/pops/pop24/c01.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: English rabbit continues Middle English rabet. Merriam-Webster traces it probably through a Walloon French form to Dutch forms, while retaining uncertainty about that route. Its recorded English history begins in the fourteenth century. This is an English etymology: the Malay translation arnab is a separate word, not a morphological development of rabbit. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rabbit)

etymology.historical_story: One established origin of Russell is the Norman French russel, a diminutive related to rous, meaning red. It could identify someone associated with red hair before becoming a hereditary surname. This explains a historical naming tradition, not the appearance, ancestry, or identity of every modern person called Russell. Source: [Patrick Woulfe, Irish Names and Surnames](https://libraryireland.booksulster.com/names/r/ruiseil.php).

etymology.historical_story: Remeh is treated here as an established Malay base rather than assigned an unverified ancient origin. Its word family shows how judgments of importance become actions: remeh describes something insignificant, while meremehkan means treating something as insignificant. The rhyming form remeh-temeh groups small, supposedly unimportant matters together, making it especially useful when discussing everyday disagreements and priorities.

etymology.historical_story: English raccoon comes from a Powhatan word recorded in several spellings around 1600. Its source is commonly interpreted as referring to scratching with the hands, an image that suits the animal’s dexterous forepaws. Malay uses the adapted spelling rakun. The animal’s name therefore connects an Indigenous American language, English borrowing, and Malay spelling adaptation. [Etymonline: raccoon](https://www.etymonline.com/word/raccoon).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect the physical and figurative meanings of rapuh: wood can break, while relationships and resolve can fail under pressure. This offers a useful cultural image of strength as something that must hold together. The consulted dictionary documents these meanings but does not establish the word's deeper historical origin.
